**Test 2**
Setting msgstream receive buffer size from **1024** to **10**, then using pprof to analyze. Result:
- About 90% memory consumed by insertBuffer;

![pprof001](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/42060877/234779154-8a5a2d76-4380-4149-bbeb-06af69d3ae95.svg)


InsertBuffer consumed about **2GB**, however, DataNode memory usage is about **5GB**, so I guess C/C++ consumed a lot of memory which we still didn’t know.

comments.author: participant3
comments.body:
**Test 4**
